vb_textbox.text: Firstly, choose your gnome and click on the basket within the allotted 1.5 second limit as I did run out of time on a few occasions. I attempted to look for any particular pattern to ensure I chose the nest performing gnome, but struggled to find anything concrete. I would advise that if the gnome you have chosen, and the subsequent wood and basket meant you gained a successful mushroom yield, I would continue to choose that particular gnome, for example if it had a purple hat, or was it's hat was taller than the other, continue to choose this until the mushroom yield starts to lessen. I would then switch over to another gnome until you are able to recognise a better pattern.
